title: Roles & Permissions
permissionHelp: Your effective permissions combine your foundational role and all current custom assignments in this organization.
roleHelp: Custom titles describe internal duties. A role assignment does not certify employment or representative status. Permission changes take effect on the next request.
noRoles: There are no custom roles in this view.
lookupRequired: Find an eligible member by exact username to manage an assignment.
noActivity: No role changes have been recorded.
name: Role name
confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this role and revoke all its current assignments?
notification: Your delegated access for an organization changed.
unavailable: This organization or role is unavailable.
changed: The role or assignment changed. Refresh and check the current permissions.
permissionProtected: This permission is reserved or unavailable.
duplicate: An active role already uses this name.
grantDenied: This assignment is outside your delegated authority.
relationshipUnavailable: The recipient needs a current affiliation or representative position in this organization.
